title: 市场抛售中国互联网：这家外资却在加仓，为何？
speaker: Pukesai

segments.en: Yes, so from a broader perspective, we have been hedging ourselves a bit in a sense that as we are adding to the AI trade, whether you look at us adding more to the China Internet names as they get so off by the market, but we are still positive about the longer-term trajectory and the strategy that the both companies are taking.
segments.zh: 从更广的视角看，我们一直在做一定对冲。比如在AI交易中，我们增持了中国互联网公司，尽管市场抛售，但我们对其长期轨迹和公司战略仍持乐观态度。

segments.en: We are also adding more to the likes of financials, for example, where earnings have also been relatively resilient, and some of the consumer stocks also have pretty high dividend use.
segments.zh: 我们也在增持金融类公司，它们的盈利相对稳健，一些消费类公司的股息率也较高。

segments.en: So a bit of a well-strategy there, where we are invested in both the high dividend use stocks in China, but also the growth stocks like China Internet.
segments.zh: 这是一种均衡策略，既配置中国高股息标的，也配置中国互联网等成长型标的。

segments.en: And within this, when you talk about the AI trade, we have also been doing quite a fair bit of what you call China AI localization play, investing in the KPEX equipments.
segments.zh: 在AI交易中，我们也在做所谓的中国AI本土化布局，投资于资本开支相关的设备领域。

segments.en: As we know that when we look at and connect the dots, companies are really uping their game with regard to KPEX, and therefore we would want to be part of that supply chain story in China as well.
segments.zh: 我们看到企业确实在加大资本开支，因此我们也希望参与中国这一供应链的故事。
